title: cleome isomeris
intro: Cleome isomeris, commonly known as Spider Flower, is a plant species native to the tropical regions of Central America and Mexico. It is valued for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits such as reducing inflammation and aiding in the treatment of respiratory issues, including bronchitis and asthma. The plant's therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, making it a potential remedy for wounds, infections, and oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of Cleome isomeris include saponins, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal and therapeutic effects.
